name: Ambiguous Organization Build Lock
postCreateCommand: if [ -f .devcontainer/scripts/post-create.sh ]; then bash .devcontainer/scripts/post-create.sh; else set -eu; export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends bat direnv fd-find hyperfine jq make man-db procps ripgrep shellcheck tree xz-utils; machine="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; case "${machine}" in amd64) go_arch=amd64; go_sha=5c2c3b16caefa1d968a94c1daca04a7ca301a496d9b086e17ad77bb81393f053; node_arch=x64; node_sha=55aa7153f9d88f28d765fcdad5ae6945b5c0f98a36881703817e4c450fa76742; gh_arch=amd64; gh_sha=83d5c2ccad5498f58bf6368acb1ab32588cf43ab3a4b1c301bf36328b1c8bd60 ;; arm64) go_arch=arm64; go_sha=fe4789e92b1f33358680864bbe8704289e7bb5fc207d80623c308935bd696d49; node_arch=arm64; node_sha=58c9520501f6ae2b52d5b210444e24b9d0c029a58c5011b797bc1fe7105886f6; gh_arch=arm64; gh_sha=06f86ec7103d41993b76cd78072f43595c34aaa56506d971d9860e67140bf909 ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture: ${machine}" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go1.26.5.linux-${go_arch}.tar.gz" -o /tmp/go.tar.gz; echo "${go_sha}  /tmp/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; rm -rf /usr/local/go; tar -xzf /tmp/go.tar.gz -C /usr/local; rm -f /tmp/go.tar.gz; curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.18.0/node-v24.18.0-linux-${node_arch}.tar.xz" -o /tmp/node.tar.xz; echo "${node_sha}  /tmp/node.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xJf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C /usr/local --strip-components=1; rm -f /tmp/node.tar.xz; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v2.96.0/gh_2.96.0_linux_${gh_arch}.tar.gz" -o /tmp/gh.tar.gz; echo "${gh_sha}  /tmp/gh.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xzf /tmp/gh.tar.gz -C /tmp; install -m 0755 "/tmp/gh_2.96.0_linux_${gh_arch}/bin/gh" /usr/local/bin/gh; rm -rf /tmp/gh.tar.gz "/tmp/gh_2.96.0_linux_${gh_arch}"; ln -sf /usr/bin/batcat /usr/local/bin/bat; ln -sf /usr/bin/fdfind /usr/local/bin/fd; for tool in /usr/local/go/bin/go /go/bin/*; do if [ -x "${tool}" ]; then ln -sf "${tool}" "/usr/local/bin/$(basename "${tool}")"; fi; done; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; fi
